feeds.title: R. Stuart & Co. Winery Blog
feeds.description: Rob Stuart is a Pacific Northwest veteran winemaker; both his personality and his winemaking style are warm and accessible. His wife Maria loves to cook for friends old and new, but her day job includes the winery's Marketing, Hospitality, and Public Relations. After years of working with other people, we were finally able to realize the dream of creating the winery we'd always imagined. One where the quality of the wines is consistently high, but their price isn't.

feeds.title: Brooks Wine Blog
feeds.description: Brooks is the living legacy of Jimi Brooks, a visionary Portland native who came to wine through his passion for history and philosophy. Together, we carry forward his commitment to the land, the wine, and each other. At Brooks, we believe that good wine starts with being good to our planet and our people. We work just as hard at growing our grapes and making superior wine as we do at making tomorrow a better place for each and every one of us.

feeds.title: Oregon Wine Press
feeds.description: Oregon Wine Press is a monthly consumer publication dedicated to Oregon wine, pinot noir, food, vineyards, winemakers, and insider-industry happenings. Established in 1984, OWP was re-imagined in 2006 by the News-Register, which is located in the heart of wine country, McMinnville, Oregon.

feeds.title: Wine Camp
feeds.description: Craig Camp is a biodynamic winegrower in Oregon's Applegate Valley. During a college semester spent studying in Europe, he discovered fine wine and food. Later on, he pursued an education in wine production and spent the next three years happily working in Italy. His single-minded goal in life is to make great wine.

feeds.title: Knudsen Vineyards News
feeds.description: Knudsen Vineyards is an iconic vineyard in the heart of the acclaimed Dundee Hills AVA overlooking the fertile Willamette Valley, majestic Mt. Hood, and the North Cascade mountain range. Our family has grown grapes and made wine here for 45 years. Our goal is to produce exceptional quality, distinctive Pinot noir and Chardonnay wines. The formula is straightforward. We care for our land and vines by practicing sustainable viticulture.

feeds.title: Capiche Wine Marketing & PR​ Blog
feeds.description: The Capiche team's passion centers around how businesses positively affect their bottom line by discovering their unique brand and then 'living' the brand-all while engaging staff and creating lifelong fans. Chris Cook brings decades of successful collaborations with graphic designers on branding, publications, and websites as well as a stellar record of public relations, marketing, and storytelling on behalf of her clients.

feeds.title: Sweet Cheeks Winery Blog
feeds.description: D.I.Y. Spirit Welcome to the Sweet Cheeks Winery blog, where you'll get a behind-the-scenes look into the stories at the root of it all. Explore article categories Browse all articles. Dan's story is one of grit and determination. There were plenty of years he had to be crafty - but two things are certain, he loved creating a family and never turned down an adventure.

feeds.title: Portland Wine Company News
feeds.description: Portland Wine Company is a full-service winery and tasting room with indoor and outdoor seating and event space located in beautiful inner SE Portland, Oregon. We've been making fretted-over, hand-crafted, small-batch, un-manipulated, nuanced Love & Squalor Wine since 2006. Portland Wine Company blog has articles on wine production to wine tasting and much more.

feeds.title: Ridgecrest Wines Blog
feeds.description: In 1980, we purchased the first vineyard on Ribbon Ridge. With barely 800 acres planted to vine, the Willamette Valley had just begun to envision such luxuries as vineyard consultants and planting crews. With 38 harvests under our belt and 41 acres under vine, we currently sell fruit from Ridgecrest Vineyards to friends in the valley and produce our own two brands, RR and RIDGECREST, at the Carlton Winemaker's Studio.

feeds.title: The Portland Bottle Shop Blog
feeds.description: The Portland Bottle Shop serves hand-crafted sandwiches, East Coast-inspired subs, soups, and salads, along with wine by the glass and 8 rotating taps. Whether you are meeting friends for lunch, taking the family out to dinner, or needing a bottle of wine or beer, we look forward to seeing you soon.

feeds.title: King Estate Blog
feeds.description: Our Blog includes recipes, news, and stories about our winery. Founded in 1991 by the King family with a deep commitment to sustainable farming, King Estate is the largest Biodynamic certified vineyard in North America. Discover how our uniquely integrated ecosystem, located in Oregon's prestigious Willamette Valley, is ideal for making remarkable wines.

feeds.title: Winerabble News
feeds.description: Since we live in the Pacific Northwest, an area where the wine industry is booming, Winerabble's content is generally focused on wines from the Western US. Between Oregon, Washington, and California, we lead the nation in acres of grapes as well as tons of wine produced. We also work in the Oregon wine industry, frequently meeting the winemakers, visiting the wineries, and making personal connections with those producing the wines we drink.

feeds.title: Oregon Winette
feeds.description: Oregon Winette is a blog about wine - the grapes, the ground, the people, and the tasting experiences. We simply love wine and want to share it with others! While much of the blog is focused on Oregon-grown wines, we also enjoy trying new varietals from different wine regions around the world too! Find reviews about high-end, small-lot Pinot Noir to the best-bottom shelf finds at the grocery store.

feeds.title: A Great Oregon Wine Tour Blog
feeds.description: We are Wayne and Camille Oppenheimer, The King and Queen of wine country. When you book a tour with us we will be your first contact and maybe even your guides. We met in wine country and together have developed one of the top-rated wine tour businesses in Oregon. Our years of working in this industry, our experiences, and building our circle of friends and colleagues in this industry were really training for being the ultimate tour guides.

feeds.title: Laurel Ridge Blog
feeds.description: Stay up-to-date with news and events from Laurel Ridge Winery & the Oregon Winemaking community as well as recipe inspiration and other musings. Laurel Ridge is situated on a 240-acre estate vineyard, in the Yamhill-Carlton sub-appellation of the Willamette Valley AVA. The estate was fondly named Finn Hill when it was purchased by Laurel Ridge founder David Teppola in 1974, a nod to his Finnish heritage.

feeds.title: Youngberg Hill Blog
feeds.description: Nicolette and Wayne took a great leap of faith in 2003 and moved to the Willamette Valley to make wine. Having found Youngberg Hill, they knew they had found their future, forging a dream come true. They were able to forge ahead with solid and stable winemaking practices through loving improvements to the vineyard and expansion to over 23 acres under the vine.

feeds.title: Fermentation Wine Blog
feeds.description: The Daily Wine Blog, where he has been publishing daily on issues of wine politics, the wine industry, the wine media, wine marketing, and the culture of wine since 2004. Tom Wark began his career as a wine marketer and publicist in 1990. In 1994 he opened his consultancy, Wark Communications, which serves small and medium-sized wineries and wine-related companies with media, communications, and marketing services.
